reviews.review:
Overall - game is great to kill time with your buddy, though it has some flaws and unsolved problems

I spent about 300 hours in first Remnant and the same here, and that was the best co-op game I ever played.
This one is kinda the same, but worse in many aspects. None of the mistakes were fixed in this game, literally none.
And while i could forgive them in the previous one, I can't close my eyes on them this time. Also they made even werse some of great aspects of the first game:

1) Levelling up and trait points. The worst change, which is completely killing the purpose of replayability.
This game removed good and working experience system from 1st game, and now you can only 'collect' 65 trait points, as opposed to UNLIMITED 'earning' in previous game.
So basically you can only have ONLY 8 and half traits active (6.5 from trait pionts + 2 from active classes) out of about 30, which you will achieve pretty quickly, and then you progress stops. 
You can only respec those, but the game will NOT reward you after that for spending time. You character will be maxed out very soon and from now on you can only collect garbage to uprage stuff you don't even need, like weapons you don't use, just for the sake of it.

2) Bad balance, very uneven game pace and uninteresting enemies design
On medium difficulty normal monsters pose almost no threat and die from 1-2 shots. They are not even fun to kill and are scarce for some reason. You walk and walk and finally you'll get some action for a bit, and then walk again.
No such problem in first game, enemies were there all the time, and they were fun to battle, because of their divercity and AI. Here its just shhoting moving objects of very limited types.

Bosses, on the other hand, can easily one shot you, and are more of a puzzle, than normal battle. So they feel more like a ''here we go again'' chore, than a fun battle you are looking forward to.

3) Speaking of puzzles and pacing. This game has a lot of them, and i mean A LOT. 
I would not even call it a fully action game, because a lot of time you will end up in some rom with a puzzle mostly of 3 types:
1. Jumping puzzle (as you can guess, jumping is very badly implemented, any 0.1 cm miss and you start level over, like its 1991 nintendo game)
1. Guess where we hid the button or where does this key go (you will NEVER guess)
2. Literally unsovable by logic, which you have to google and read 5 screens of pure text, explainig an insane sequence of actions you have to execute.
Or you can spend 5-10+ hours, reading some f-ing books and trying everything just to get some garbage weapon, mod, or whatever.
Such things are a disgrace and have nothing to do with self-respecting coop shooter. If we wanted to play Portal 2 or whatever, we would play that.
It is NOT fun, it is waste of our very limited time

Also there are a lot of illusory walls, which have 0 (i mean none, zero) indication or logic behind them. LIke, in Dark Souls series you could always guess a wall. There - no, sir, any normal wall might be a secret, so you have to either badge at ALL walls, or just use guides

4) Speaking of jumps - quality of life in this game is non-existing. While playing you will constantly ask yourself - WHY COULD NOT THEY MAKE IT GOOD?

Im talking insta death falls with no ressurection, bad weapon management and comparioson, very big hub, where you have to run all around to talk to merchants, and so on
Also VERY SLOW animations - when you want to talk to trader NPC< he will be turning to you for a good 3+ seconds. I guess that's what they call ''cinematic'', but I call it ''disrespect for player's time''

5) Maps are tiresome and boring to traverse.
They have very weird compostion and are insanely large, with 3-4 exits to other maps. So, as i was talking bedore, mostly you just walk empty spaces killing occasional enemies who just ''are'' there, not doing much, then explore other connected maps, whch are a bit less tedious usually, because they are smaller, then you return to main map, kill gimmik boss and that's it, reroll world and go again.
But for what?

6) There a LOT of ♥♥♥♥ in this game you can collect, but you don't realy need anything. You will very soon collect DOZENS of rings, amulets, relics and whatnot, like 5 ring on one small map, but you have little use for them, because you have only 4 slots fot them and 1 for amulet, and most of them are just meh, and thir quantity just devalues them

Also armor sets now are totally useless, they don't do ANYTING, pure cosmetics, except for slightly different armor stats, which do not affect the game in any way.

Started this up to play some DLC and was plagued with crashes. its so bad this game specifically is crashing my PC. Online help from ARC is a ghost town. bummer i cant even play anymore for something i bought....
I also check with some friends and they were also getting issues this bad so it doesn't appear to be an isolated incident. I'm suspecting the root of the problem is regarding the GPU/DX11 or 12 and it thinking i ran out of memory (highly unlikely considering my set up).

Wonder if i can get a refund this late after playing it...

Some things i did to trouble shoot
Windows compatibility mode for both 7 & 8
Force DX11 on startup
use thunderbolt to adjust my Cores on my CPU (dumbing down my CPU known issue for 13th gen and up)
reinstall game

all unfortunately to no avail...

my rig
RTX3090 Ti
32 gb ram DDR5
i9-14900k
Driver version GPU 552.22 (latest at this time)
monitor : Odyssey 9
Windows 11 (unfortunatly)
